name: Controls
notes: Explains the buttons; back to the title menu at the end.

lines.text: D-PAD RUNS. A JUMPS: HOLD IT LONGER TO JUMP HIGHER.
B SWINGS YOUR NAIL. HOLD UP TO SLASH UP. HOLD DOWN IN THE AIR TO SLASH DOWN AND BOUNCE OFF FOES AND SPIKES.
HITS FILL YOUR SOUL. HOLD L TO FOCUS: 33 SOUL HEALS ONE MASK. STAND STILL WHILE YOU DO.
R DASHES AND A TAP OF L CASTS A SPELL, ONCE YOU FIND THEM. UP TALKS AND RESTS ON BENCHES. START PAUSES.
